response.overview: dream*time*travel (out of capitalism) lingers between a guided meditation, a (dream*)time travel and the prothesis of the self in the digital sphere. It questions self care procedures in western societies and how these are affected and emptied due to the ruling capitalist system. The body floats in the digital space, slowly degrading as well as the imagined (and real) woods.
response.title: dream*time*travel (out of capitalism)
